depth_targets.title: HTTP, Pub/Sub and App Engine HTTP targets
limitations: A Pub/Sub target is delivered into Vyomi's Pub/Sub core for real — a subscriber receives an actual message.
HTTP and App Engine HTTP targets are recorded as attempted (lastAttemptTime/status are stamped); Vyomi makes no outbound network call, so the target URL is never actually invoked.
OAuth and OIDC auth headers are stored and returned to the SDK exactly as configured but are not verified or used to sign an outbound request.

depth_targets.title: App Engine cron jobs (legacy cron.yaml)
limitations: App Engine isn't modeled in Vyomi, so the legacy cron.yaml-based jobs the real console lists under this tab have no backend to read from.
